h1: Bette bathroom installation in Wentworth Estate

hero.intro: Wentworth Estate is the private, gated community in Virginia Water built around Wentworth Club and its golf courses, home of the BMW PGA Championship, and sits around 15 to 20 minutes by road from our Bracknell base. Installations here often specify Bette: a bath or shower tray made from titanium-steel finished with fused glass enamel, harder and more scratch-resistant than acrylic, but dependent on a properly built substructure underneath it. We bring the same fit-only model to the estate as everywhere else we work, with the added step of coordinating access with the estate and any managing agent so a gated address doesn't slow the programme down.

sections.heading: A material built for exacting homes
sections.body: Bette's baths and shower trays are formed from titanium-steel and finished with fused glass enamel, a surface that resists scratching and everyday wear noticeably better than acrylic. That durability is exactly why it turns up often in the kind of high-specification bathroom found on Wentworth Estate. The trade-off is that the shell is unforgiving: it doesn't flex to absorb an unevenly built base the way acrylic does, so a Bette installation has to get the groundwork right before the bath or tray is anywhere near the room.

sections.heading: Working inside a gated estate
sections.body: We fit bathrooms for homeowners on Wentworth Estate as part of our regular work in Virginia Water and the surrounding area, roughly 15 to 20 minutes from our Bracknell base. A gated estate adds a layer most installations don't need: booking access in advance, working with any managing agent's requirements, and keeping deliveries, skips and trade vehicles moving through the gate without holding up the day's work. We build that coordination into the programme from the survey stage, not as an afterthought once strip-out has already started.

sections.heading: The substructure a Bette bath actually needs
sections.body: Underneath a Bette shell, we build a level, braced substructure sized to the specific bath or tray, and isolate it acoustically so sound doesn't carry through the floor below. Skipping any part of that is how a titanium-steel bath ends up with a hollow sound, a loose feel, or movement at the waste connection. Because the material doesn't mask an imperfect base, getting this stage right matters more with Bette than with most other baths we fit.

sections.heading: How the installation runs, start to finish
sections.body: You source the Bette bath or shower tray, along with your brassware, tiles and furniture; we handle strip-out, first-fix plumbing, substructure build, tiling, fitting the bath and brassware, and a final snag. It starts with a £125 survey, where we also confirm estate access arrangements and any managing agent requirements alongside the usual checks on floor structure and waste position. Installs start from £3,500.

sections.heading: Enquire about a survey
sections.body: If you're planning a Bette bathroom on Wentworth Estate, get in touch to arrange a survey and we'll sort access with the estate as part of booking the job. Call or WhatsApp 07399 651836.

faqs.q: Can you get access onto Wentworth Estate for deliveries and skips?
faqs.a: Yes, we coordinate access with the estate and any managing agent as part of booking the survey and the job, so gate arrangements don't hold up the installation programme.

faqs.q: How far is Wentworth Estate from your base?
faqs.a: Around 15 to 20 minutes by road from our base in Bracknell.

faqs.q: Why does a Bette bath need special installation?
faqs.a: Its titanium-steel shell with a fused glass enamel finish doesn't flex like acrylic, so it needs a level, braced and acoustically isolated substructure built specifically for it, rather than being dropped into a generic base.

faqs.q: Do I buy the bathroom products myself?
faqs.a: Yes. We work fit-only: you buy the Bette bath or shower tray, brassware, tiles and furniture, and we carry out strip-out, first-fix, tiling, plumbing and snagging.

faqs.q: What does an installation on Wentworth Estate cost?
faqs.a: Installs start from £3,500, with the final price depending on the scope of work confirmed at the £125 survey.
We assess the floor, waste position and access route, confirm the substructure your chosen Bette model needs, and agree estate access arrangements for the installation.

image.heroPrompt: Purpose: hero image for a Bette bathroom installation page targeting Wentworth Estate. Subject and action: a Bette freestanding bath, titanium-steel with a fused glass enamel finish, set within a spacious ensuite bathroom. Setting and work-stage: a completed installation in a large detached house, dark basalt stone flooring and a feature wall in anthracite tone. Composition: three-quarter angle shot from a corner of the room, bath positioned centrally with a window and part of a stone-clad wall visible behind it. Light and materials: bright midday daylight through a large window, brushed nickel bath filler and waste, dark basalt stone showing natural texture and varied matte sheen rather than gloss. Constraints: no people, no text, no logos, no brand names visible on fixtures, no LED strip lighting under every shelf or niche or mirror at once, no catalog-symmetrical twin fittings unless genuinely a double vanity, no single uniform amber or gold colour wash across the frame, no hanging plants or florals or candles as props, no water shown running, varied and believable sheen rather than uniform hyper-gloss.
